mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 3.0% (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and producing positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as the market prices in lower cost of capital.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0% (current vintage_value).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration and recession risk, triggering immediate negative 5-day S&P 500 returns due to profit growth concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate weakening demand, causing negative 60-day S&P 500 returns as the market anticipates economic contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST both decline.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing contraction (INDPRO below 100) signals reduced industrial output and profit growth, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns during economic slowdowns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, generating positive 5-day S&P 500 returns through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative 60-day S&P 500 returns due to higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market distress (e.g., job cuts without unemployment rise), causing negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS and UNRATE both decline.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 110 (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing output and sustained corporate earnings, generating positive 60-day S&P 500 returns during industrial expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 110.
